selection: hits descending, sum of router weights descending, expert ID ascending, per layer
relative_weight_definition: hits / sum(hits of the 27 selected experts in this layer)
all_expert_share_definition: hits / total recorded expert selections of all 512 experts in this layer
scope: Descriptive all-120-case ranking requested by user; not a held-out accuracy claim.
runtime_threshold: Missing CURRENT softmax mass < 0.10, per token/layer. Static relative weights are not used for omission.
extension: Preserve the first 24; append ranks 25, 26, 27 from the same saved generation ranking. No new routing campaign.
